verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for a managed database service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents ClickHouse protocol compatibility, an MCP server and a feature-status map, but never mentions versioned APIs or a deprecation policy. The feature-status map is an adjacent compatibility document, not a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
